reason: $147 a month is a big chunk of money when I make about $21k a year and my pipeline dries up every other month, and other Instagram DM tools cost a third of that. Card up front, payments final after day 3, and my main account is my storefront, so I'm not putting it on the line for a tool with zero published results.
objection: Automated sending from my main Instagram could get it flagged or banned, and I'd lose months of content and clients. The FAQ-style line about 'human pace' isn't a promise, there are no customer results, and it costs 3-4x the other tools.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $50 to $60 a month, plus real customer results from people at my size and a clear answer on what happens to my account if Instagram flags it.
